17/// An error while embedding the file.
18#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
19pub enum EmbedError {
20    /// The selected standard does not support embedding files.
21    Existence,
22    /// The document doesn't contain a modification date, which is required for embedded files
23    /// in some export modes.
24    MissingDate,
25    /// The embedded file is missing a human-readable description.
26    MissingDescription,
27    /// The mime type of the embedded file is missing.
28    MissingMimeType,
29}
30
31/// An embedded file.
32#[derive(Debug, Clone, Hash)]
33pub struct EmbeddedFile {
34    /// The name of the embedded file.
35    pub path: String,
36    /// The mime type of the embedded file.
37    pub mime_type: Option<MimeType>,
38    /// A description of the embedded file.
39    pub description: Option<String>,
40    /// The association kind of the embedded file.
41    pub association_kind: AssociationKind,
42    /// The raw data of the embedded file.
43    pub data: Data,
44    /// The modification date of the embedded file.
45    pub modification_date: Option<DateTime>,
46    /// Whether the embedded file should be compressed (recommended to turn off if the
47    /// original file already has compression). If `None`, krilla will use its own logic
48    /// for determining whether to compress the file or not.
49    pub compress: Option<bool>,
50    /// The location of the embedded file.
51    pub location: Option<Location>,
52}
53
54impl Cacheable for EmbeddedFile {
55    fn serialize(self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, chunk_container: &mut ChunkContainer, root_ref: Ref) {
56        sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::EmbeddedFile(EmbedError::Existence, self.location));
57
58        let chunk = &mut chunk_container.non_stream.embedded_files;
59        let mut stream_chunk = sc.new_chunk();
60        let stream_ref = sc.new_ref();
61
62        let file_stream = match self.compress {
63            Some(true) => FilterStreamBuilder::new_from_binary_data(self.data.as_ref()),
64            Some(false) => FilterStreamBuilder::new_from_uncompressed(self.data.as_ref()),
65            None => FilterStreamBuilder::new_auto_compressed(self.data.as_ref()),
66        }
67        .finish(&sc.serialize_settings());
68
69        let mut embedded_file_stream = stream_chunk.embedded_file(stream_ref, file_stream.encoded_data());
70        file_stream.write_filters(embedded_file_stream.deref_mut().deref_mut());
71
72        if let Some(mime_type) = &self.mime_type {
73            embedded_file_stream.subtype(mime_type.0.to_pdf_name());
74        } else {
75            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::EmbeddedFile(EmbedError::MissingMimeType, self.location));
76        }
77
78        let mut params = embedded_file_stream.params();
79        params.size(self.data.as_ref().len() as i32);
80
81        if let Some(date_time) = &self.modification_date {
82            let date = pdf_date(*date_time);
83            params.modification_date(date);
84        } else {
85            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::EmbeddedFile(EmbedError::MissingDate, self.location));
86        }
87
88        params.finish();
89        embedded_file_stream.finish();
90
91        let mut file_spec = chunk.file_spec(root_ref);
92        file_spec.path(Str(self.path.as_bytes()));
93
94        if sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version() >= PdfVersion::Pdf17 {
95            file_spec.unic_file(TextStr(&self.path));
96        }
97
98        let mut ef = file_spec.insert(Name(b"EF")).dict();
99        ef.pair(Name(b"F"), stream_ref);
100
101        if sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version() >= PdfVersion::Pdf17 {
102            ef.pair(Name(b"UF"), stream_ref);
103        }
104
105        ef.finish();
106
107        if sc.serialize_settings().supports_associated_files() {
108            file_spec.association_kind(self.association_kind.to_pdf());
109        }
110
111        if let Some(description) = self.description {
112            file_spec.description(TextStr(&description));
113        } else {
114            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::EmbeddedFile(EmbedError::MissingDescription, self.location));
115        }
116
117        file_spec.finish();
118        chunk_container.streams.embedded_files.push(stream_chunk);
119    }
120}

122/// How an embedded file relates to the PDF document it is embedded in.
123#[derive(Debug, Copy, Clone, Eq, PartialEq, Hash)]
124pub enum AssociationKind {
125    /// The PDF document was created from this source file.
126    Source,
127    /// This file was used to derive a visual presentation in the PDF.
128    Data,
129    /// An alternative representation of this document.
130    Alternative,
131    /// Additional resources for this document.
132    Supplement,
133    /// There is no clear relationship or it is not known.
134    Unspecified,
135}
136
137impl AssociationKind {
138    fn to_pdf(self) -> pdf_writer::types::AssociationKind {
139        match self {
140            AssociationKind::Source => pdf_writer::types::AssociationKind::Source,
141            AssociationKind::Data => pdf_writer::types::AssociationKind::Data,
142            AssociationKind::Alternative => pdf_writer::types::AssociationKind::Alternative,
143            AssociationKind::Supplement => pdf_writer::types::AssociationKind::Supplement,
144            AssociationKind::Unspecified => pdf_writer::types::AssociationKind::Unspecified,
145        }
146    }
147}

149/// A mime type.
150#[derive(Debug, Clone, Hash)]
151pub struct MimeType(String);
152
153impl MimeType {
154    /// Create a new mime type.
155    ///
156    /// Returns `None` if the mime type is invalid.
157    pub fn new(mime_type: &str) -> Option<Self> {
158        if valid_mime_type(mime_type) { Some(Self(mime_type.to_string())) } else { None }
159    }
160}
161
162fn valid_mime_type(mime_type: &str) -> bool {
163    let parts: Vec<&str> = mime_type.split('/').collect();
164    if parts.len() != 2 {
165        return false;
166    }
167
168    let (type_part, subtype_part) = (parts[0], parts[1]);
169
170    valid_mime_part(type_part) && valid_mime_part(subtype_part)
171}
172
173fn valid_mime_part(part: &str) -> bool {
174    if part.is_empty() {
175        return false;
176    }
177
178    part.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '+' || c == '.')
179}

181#[cfg(any())]
182mod tests {
183    use super::*;
184
185    #[cfg(any())]
186    fn valid_mime_types() {
187        assert!(valid_mime_type("text/plain"));
188        assert!(valid_mime_type("application/pdf"));
189        assert!(valid_mime_type("image/jpeg"));
190        assert!(valid_mime_type("application/octet-stream"));
191        assert!(valid_mime_type("text/html"));
192        assert!(valid_mime_type("application/json"));
193        assert!(valid_mime_type("image/png"));
194        assert!(valid_mime_type("video/mp4"));
195        assert!(valid_mime_type("audio/mpeg"));
196        assert!(valid_mime_type("application/vnd.ms-excel"));
197        assert!(valid_mime_type("text/css"));
198        assert!(valid_mime_type("application/x-www-form-urlencoded"));
199        assert!(valid_mime_type("multipart/form-data"));
200        assert!(valid_mime_type("application/xml+svg"));
201        assert!(valid_mime_type("text/plain+charset"));
202    }
203
204    #[cfg(any())]
205    fn invalid_mime_types() {
206        assert!(!valid_mime_type("source"));
207        assert!(!valid_mime_type("text/"));
208        assert!(!valid_mime_type("/plain"));
209        assert!(!valid_mime_type(""));
210        assert!(!valid_mime_type("text"));
211        assert!(!valid_mime_type("text/plain/extra"));
212        assert!(!valid_mime_type("text plain"));
213        assert!(!valid_mime_type("text\\plain"));
214        assert!(!valid_mime_type("text@plain"));
215        assert!(!valid_mime_type("text/plain*"));
216    }
217}
